mainText: Good morning, Bryan. Today's verse is Proverbs chapter 27, verse 23: Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks, and look well to thy herds. This is a test of your morning briefing. Starting tomorrow, your full devotional, reading and affirmation will play here each morning.
Your card today is The Hierophant, upright: trust proven wisdom and tradition. Your color is deep burgundy, and face North. Today is a new moon.
Today's affirmation: Every day my clinic grows stronger, my books grow clearer, and abundance flows to the work of my hands.
